title: Does the new shape fit?
hints: A reshape is allowed when both shapes hold the same number of elements. The number of axes does not matter.
`count` already gives the number of elements in a shape. Call it on both shapes.
explain: A reshape keeps every element, so it is allowed exactly when the two shapes have the same element count: `count old_shape = count new_shape`. The rank is free to change, which is why `[6]` can become `[2; 3]`. The empty shape is a scalar. Its count is 1, because the fold starts from 1, so `[1]` can become `[]`.
